mapper.insert: INSERT INTO health_profiles ( user_id, height_cm, weight_kg, target_weight_kg, birth_date, gender, health_goal, activity_level, diet_styles_json, restricted_foods_json, allergies_json, target_calories, target_protein_g, target_carbs_g, target_fat_g, target_sodium_mg, target_fiber_g, nutrition_standard_version, nutrition_target_calculated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{heightCm}, #{weightKg}, #{targetWeightKg}, #{birthDate}, #{gender}, #{healthGoal}, #{activityLevel}, #{dietStylesJson}, #{restrictedFoodsJson}, #{allergiesJson}, #{targetCalories}, #{targetProteinG}, #{targetCarbsG}, #{targetFatG}, #{targetSodiumMg}, #{targetFiberG}, #{nutritionStandardVersion}, #{nutritionTargetCalculatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT health_profile_id, user_id, height_cm, weight_kg, target_weight_kg, birth_date, gender, health_goal, activity_level, diet_styles_json, restricted_foods_json, allergies_json, target_calories, target_protein_g, target_carbs_g, target_fat_g, target_sodium_mg, target_fiber_g, nutrition_standard_version, nutrition_target_calculated_at, created_at, updated_at FROM health_profiles WHERE user_id = #{userId}
